name: Web To Print Shop : Pricematrix
author: w2pshop

sections.description:
Web To Print Shop : Pricematrix Plugin

W2P Shop’s centralized Price Matrix plug-in is a centralized product options and pricing calculator. It is a comprehensive matrix on the back end allowing you to add all sorts of options and calculations that most ‘product options’ plug-ins can not handle. It displays as an intuitive calculator on the front end that can also be custom designed to any front end design. This plugin is part of the comprehensive online print ordering modules available by Web to Print Shop. The calculator takes various aspects into account, such as material type, size, volume discounts, international currencies, and shipping. The tool provides customers with an instant quote, offering them on-the-spot web to print pricing. It is centralized within the platform so that prices only need to be set up once, and then all future published products are easier to add.

Features

  • Excel Upload Price Calculator
  • Dynamic Sizing
  • Cascading Options
  • Price Estimator Library
  • Wide Format Capabilities
  • Instant Quoting
  • Integration with Multiple Template Editors such as uDRAW, PDFLib, XMPie and Web to Print Cloud

Use of External Services

This plugin communicates with our proprietary endpoints hosted at Web to Print Solutions to validate API credentials and process price-matrix data for accurate display on the product pages. The transmitted information includes your API credentials and the pricing data used to calculate product costs.
sections.installation:
Requires
Plugin: WooCommerce

  1. Unzip and upload contents of the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
